name: html-preview
description: Opens HTML files Claude writes (or /preview <file>) in terminal-browser

mode.title: Where to show the page
mode.description: pane: the terminal-browser plugin's pane inside Claude Code; split: a terminal split via the terminal-browser CLI; auto: pane when that plugin is installed, else split

split.title: Split direction
split.description: Direction for the CLI split (mode split, or auto without the plugin)

autoOpen.title: Auto-open written HTML
autoOpen.description: Preview each .html file the Write or Edit tool saves
